text:
TCI 麻醉时麻醉效应呈协同作用。
Isobolographic Analysis of Pharmacodynamic Interactions Between Propofol and Etomidate for Colonoscopy
LI You－wu，LI Cheng－long，Tu Xue－yun，et al．( Department of Anesthesiology，the Second Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital of Guangdong Province，Guangzhou 510095，China)【Abstract 】 Objective To investigate the pharmacodynamic interactions between propofol and etomidate with Isobolographic analysis in colonoscopy anesthesia． Methods One hundred and fifty －eight patients undergoing colonoscopy receiving intravenous anesthesia were divided into three groups( Group P，with propofol TCI; Group E，with etomidate TCI; Group C with propofol－etomidate combination TCI) ． Using up－and－down sequential allocation methodology，the $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ of three groups was calculated，then Isobologram was drawn，and the changes of physiological indexes during colonoscopy was recorded． Results The $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ value of Group P was estimated to be 4． $1 5 \mu \mathrm { g } / \mathrm { m L }$ ［95% confidence interval ( CI) 3． 5 ～ 4． 8］，the $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ value of Group E was estimated to be 400 ng /mL ［95% confidence interval ( CI) 370 ～ 425］． The $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ values of P / E combination was estimated to be 1． 28 /220，The deviation of the location of $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ of P / E combination from the connecting line was statistically significant， $P { < } 0 . 0 5$ ． Conclusion The pharmacodynamic interaction between propofol and etomidate was synergetic．药物联合通过药代动力学和药效学机制产生相加、协同和拮抗作用，取长补短联合用药已成为临床麻醉的必然趋势 。 等辐射分析法( Isobolographic a-nalysis) 是一种分析药物之间相互作用的方法，对于药物联合应用后药物效应的改变，能予以简洁、精确的定量分析［1］。 丙泊酚和依托咪酯均属非巴比妥类静脉全麻药，具有起效快、苏醒迅速且并发症少的优点。 本研究应用等辐射分析法对无痛结肠镜检查术时异丙酚与依托咪酯二药的相互作用及临床效果进行探讨。
